name: Zurich Airport

hours.quote: Die Betriebszeiten des Flughafens Zürich liegen zwischen 06:00 und 23:30 Uhr.

curfew.v: no flights from 23:30 to 06:00 unless an exemption permit is granted; 23:00 to 23:30 is kept only for clearing delays
curfew.quote: Die letzte halbe Stunde (23:00–23:30) ist für den Verspätungsabbau reserviert. ... Während der Sperrzeit benötigen alle Flugzeuge eine Ausnahmebewilligung

runway.v: longest runway, runway 34, is 3,700 m long

slots.v: every IFR movement needs an airport slot before departure or arrival, including positioning, training and maintenance flights; IFR slots come via the dispatcher or handling agent (FBO)
slots.quote: Each IFR aircraft movement is required to previously obtain a mandatory airport slot; this includes positioning, training and flights into/out of maintenance facilities.

handling.v: operators must use one of the handling agents listed in AIP Switzerland for LSZH (unless self-handling is authorised); the airport names BHS Aviation Switzerland AG, Cat Air Service AG, Jet Aviation AG, Motorfluggruppe Zürich, SWISS PRIVILEGE AVIATION SERVICES GmbH and Travelcoup as business-aviation FBOs
handling.quote: Der Handling-Anbieter (FBO) ihrer Wahl kümmert sich um die gesamte Organisation ihres Fluges

noise.v: aircraft that normally exceed 95 dB(A) at the Oberglatt measuring point when departing north are not cleared to take off between 22:00 and 06:00; night departures are limited to aircraft within the VIL art. 39a noise limits
noise.quote: Luftfahrzeuge, die beim Abflug nach Norden an der Messstelle Oberglatt in der Regel einen höheren Lärmwert als 95 dB(A)

deicing.v: on-stand de-icing by Swissport, dnata or Jet Aviation; remote de-icing pads Charlie and Foxtrott are run by Swissport only
deicing.quote: Customers with Deicing Providers dnata or Jet Aviation

notes: Swiss eAIP (skybriefing) is paid and was not used. ICAO LSZH and IATA ZRH from the FOCA/BAZL airport page. Slot rule: Slot Coordination Switzerland states GA/BA slots cannot be requested from it; IFR slots come via dispatcher or FBO, VFR via the airport's VFR slot tool (Zurich Airport GA page: 'You need a valid airport slot before departure and/or arrival.'). Handling rule quote (slotcoordination.ch): 'Operators are obliged to choose one of the handling agents listed in AIP Switzerland LSZH'. Runway 34 length comes from a diagram label in the airport's 2023 runway-extension fact sheet; extensions of runways 28 and 32 were planned, so re-check after any change. Re-researched 2026-10-29: 29 Oct 2026: Operating regulations (Betriebsreglement vom 30. Juni 2011, Stand 20 März 2026), Anhang 1: airport open 'täglich von 06.00 Uhr bis 23.30 Uhr'; scheduled starts may be planned until 23:00 and charter starts until 22:00 (Art. 12-13); the Oberglatt 95 dB(A) rule is Art. 11; the non-commercial night ban is Art. 14. The regulation does not define 'Nachtzeit' in Art. 14; elsewhere it uses 22.00-06.00 Uhr, and BAFU states non-commercial flights are banned 22:00-06:00 nationally. Non-commercial IFR flights rank below scheduled, charter and other commercial IFR flights (Art. 21). The regulation gives no runway dimensions. The SIL object sheet Zürich was revised by the Federal Council on 19 Sep 2025 ('Tagbetrieb 06.00 bis 22.00 Uhr, Nachtbetrieb bis 23.00 Uhr'; delayed movements to 23:30 without special permit). De-icing from Winter Operation at Zurich Airport, Issue 1.0 / Revision 24 (01.10.2025); a 2026/27 edition may exist, re-check before winter. Jet Aviation's on-stand de-icing is offered to 'selected customers'.
